repo.description:
### Impact

A user with read-only permission can restore a file from the trash bin.

### Patches

It is recommended that Groupfolders app is upgraded to 14.0.11, 15.3.12, 16.0.15, 17.0.14, 18.1.8, 19.1.8 or 20.1.2

### Workarounds

* Disable the Groupfolders app
* Disable the Files_trashbin app

### References

* [PullRequest](https://github.com/nextcloud/groupfolders/pull/4076)
* [Public ticket](https://github.com/nextcloud/groupfolders/issues/4041)

### For more information

If you have any questions or comments about this advisory:

* Create a post in [nextcloud/security-advisories](https://github.com/nextcloud/security-advisories/discussions)
* Customers: Open a support ticket at [portal.nextcloud.com](https://portal.nextcloud.com)
repo.summary: Users with read-only permissions for team folder can restore deleted files from trash bin
